callbackContract.recurrence: callback remains recurrent only when its session polling slot remains nonzero after return
callbackContract.terminalBehavior: asynchronous/modal callbacks call _stop_polling on completion, cancellation, invalid session, or host-operation failure

ordering.betweenSessions: sentinel processing follows the Worldgroup input/event queue; no fixed wall-clock order is encoded
ordering.withinCallback: each callback runs synchronously to return before Worldgroup decides whether to enqueue the next polling sentinel
ordering.gameplayHeartbeat: 0x00402AAA is the only proven continuously recurrent gameplay callback; the other seven are bounded asynchronous/modal workflows

boundedUnknowns: Semantic UI names for the seven asynchronous workflows are intentionally not assigned without independent record/string provenance.
The exact wall-clock cadence remains host-load and queue-service dependent.
Persistent DFA write semantics are not inferred from read/search calls made by these callbacks and remain a separate tracing boundary.
